evidence_items.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
evidence_items.summary: GPT-6 Astra tops Retell’s voice agent benchmark, while Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.

evidence_items.title: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
evidence_items.summary: Old Ideas, Novel Problems tests how reliably LLMs judge the novelty of research ideas, finding that small changes to the evaluation setup can produce very different verdicts.
